days.title: Central Massif and Caving
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Grotta di Monte Cucco
stops.detail: The main attraction of the park is the Grotta di Monte Cucco, one of the most extensive caves in Italy: a destination for speleologists and researchers, in which an area equipped with lights, stairs and walkways has been created, visitable for tourism accompanied by specialized guides.

stops.name: Grotta di Santa Agnese
stops.detail: Of great charm is also the Grotta di Santa Agnese, a cavern of considerable size easily reachable on foot, where history and legend merge.

stops.name: Pian delle Macinare
stops.detail: The Pian delle Macinare plateau represents a main hub for hiking trails that develop for about 100 km throughout the park.

stops.name: Forra di Rio Freddo
stops.detail: The eastern slope of the mountain is furrowed by the Forra di Rio Freddo, an imposing canyon descended every year by hundreds of canyoning enthusiasts.

stops.name: Val di Ranco

stops.name: Corno del Catria
stops.detail: Eagles are rarely spotted (but it is not quite rare to spot hawks) the nesting sites are located at the far north of the park, on the walls of Corno del Catria.
